scripts.migrate:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --env development --migrations-path migrations --config config/config.cjs
scripts.migrate:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --env test --migrations-path migrations --config config/config.cjs
scripts.migrate:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --env production --migrations-path migrations --config config/config.cjs
scripts.migrate:status:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:status --env development --migrations-path migrations --config config/config.cjs
scripts.migrate:status:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:status --env test --migrations-path migrations --config config/config.cjs
scripts.migrate:status:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:status --env production --migrations-path migrations --config config/config.cjs
scripts.seed:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --env development --seeders-path seeders --config config/config.cjs
scripts.seed:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --env test --seeders-path seeders --config config/config.cjs
scripts.seed:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --env production --seeders-path seeders --config config/config.cjs
scripts.seed:undo:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all --seeders-path seeders --env development --config config/config.cjs
scripts.seed:undo:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all --seeders-path seeders --env test --config config/config.cjs
scripts.seed:undo:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all --seeders-path seeders --env production --config config/config.cjs
scripts.fresh:dev: echo First remove type module from package.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --config config/config.cjs --migrations-path migrations && npm run migrate:dev && npm run seed:dev
scripts.fresh:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --config config/config.cjs --migrations-path migrations && npm run migrate:test && npm run seed:test
scripts.fresh:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --config config/config.cjs --migrations-path migrations && npm run migrate:prod
